outline.title: Eight-month home routine of Nicoletta Palmi
outline.note: Synthetic habit-mining horizon for a 42-year-old high-school professor living in a villa near Rimini.

habits.label: Wake up on a regular schedule
habits.note: Earlier on school days and slightly later during holidays.

habits.label: Morning toilet and shower
habits.note: Daily morning hygiene before breakfast or work.

habits.label: Prepare and eat breakfast
habits.note: Usually at home before leaving for school.

habits.label: Teach at Idioms High School
habits.note: School teaching and related duties on weekdays.

habits.label: Take contraceptive pill when scheduled
habits.note: Modeled as a regular 21-dose monthly cycle; exact medical scheduling is not inferred beyond the supplied description.

habits.label: Cook dinner at home
habits.note: Nicoletta enjoys cooking and prepares dinner on most evenings.

habits.label: Gym workout
habits.note: Performed at the external gym, usually after work or on weekend mornings.

habits.label: Buy groceries
habits.note: Shopping supports her frequent home cooking.

habits.label: Watch a film at home
habits.note: The catalog's documentary intent is used as the closest executable representation of film watching.

authoringAssumptions: Nicoletta lives alone because no household members were specified.
The simulation starts on 2026-08-03 in the Europe/Rome time zone.
Her school work commitment is modeled Monday through Friday from 08:00 to 14:00 during teaching periods.
Her contraceptive pill is represented conservatively as 21 morning doses per month; exact cycle dates are left to the deterministic expander.
Gym attendance is represented with the catalog intent indoor_light_exercise at an external gym location.
Boat use has no matching executable activity-catalog intent, so it is represented as bounded non-executable outline events with intent null.
She shops for groceries approximately once per week.
She watches films mainly on weekend evenings, represented by watch_documentary.
She begins the horizon at home in the bedroom.

fixedCommitments.label: Teaching at Idioms High School
fixedCommitments.note: Synthetic school-year commitment within the eight-month horizon.

phases.label: Late-summer boating season
phases.note: Hot weekends increase outdoor and boating time.

phases.label: Winter teaching intensity
phases.note: More evenings are occupied by preparation and grading.

phases.label: Winter school holiday
phases.note: No teaching commitment and a later morning rhythm.

events.label: Boat outing from Rimini marina
events.note: Non-executable outline event because the embedded activity catalog has no boat-use intent.

events.label: Parent-teacher evening
events.note: Additional school duties beyond the regular shift.

events.label: Brief winter respiratory illness
events.note: Conservative synthetic interruption for a long horizon; no chronic condition is inferred.
